test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The laws governing the Supreme Court of India and the concept of 'procedures established by law' were adopted from the Constitution of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The laws governing the Supreme Court of India and the concept of 'Procedure established by Law' were adopted from the Japanese Constitution.
 
• The “Procedure Established by Law” means that a law duly enacted by the legislature or the concerned body is valid only if the correct procedure has been followed to the letter.
 
• By adopting the phrase "procedure established by law" the Constitution gave the legislature the final word to determine the law.
